title: feat(scenarios): order_to_cash's verified build is a committed fixture beside its card
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuDKEKdacsmHCLbg9139FUsL)_

repo:objectstack#2 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWYbeKh6ewAziS6nrf

Fixes #34920

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：把 `order_to_cash`（订单到收款）卡的已验证构建作为 fixture 提交进仓库：`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json`，与一次通过的 scratch 搭建在迭代前写出的 `dist/objectstack.json` 逐字节一致，旁边是出处文件。新增一个测试，钉住每份构建与它的出处文件、卡文件、协议版本的对应关系。`travel_expense` 的出处文件里卡的 sha256 过期了，这次一并刷新。
- 为什么改：问数日轮要每天在同一份构建上跑，之前只有 `travel_expense` 一张卡有入库构建。11-25 那次通过的构建从没交出来，而且卡和 runner 后来都改了，所以按 Sales 08:40Z 在决策卡上的选择（「本专区自己搭」），在本线程重跑了一次 opus/high 搭建：Build 174/174，Seed 619/619，一次通过。
- 用户能看到什么：没有。不改任何包的发布内容，`builds/` 不随 `@objectstack/scenarios` 发出（打包脚本只读 `docs/qa/scenarios/` 一层的 `*.json`）。评测方面，新开的容器现在不用搭建就能跑两张卡的问数轮。
- 风险与回滚：只有 fixture、文档、一个测试和两张输入登记表（`turbo.json`、跨包测试输入表），回滚就是还原这个 PR。⚠ 改动 5,500 行左右，其中 fixture 自己 5,340 行，超过 3,000 行线，要你批准或合并。fixture 刻意保持原样不压缩，因为出处里的 sha256 证明的就是这份文件。
- 两分钟验证：`sha256sum docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json`，应为 `5d1696c818d5…`，与出处文件一致；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/verified-builds.test.ts`，11 项全过。
- 需要你做的：`.claude/**`（Tier S）的 L2 审核通过后，由于超过 3,000 行，需要你批准或合并；交接由席位负责。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json` (new): the verified build ask rounds install for `order_to_cash`, byte for byte the `dist/objectstack.json` the scratch run below wrote after its Build half and before its iterate turn. sha256 `5d1696c818d542480819ddb67b970337e01ee94c224c99479f8cc9319797fcea`, 152,377 bytes, `manifest.engines.protocol` `^19`.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.provenance.json` (new): card sha256 `fb53e5cf…`, runner `b620c4b2`, packages workspace @ `b620c4b2`, driver `claude-code-cli 2.1.332` on the subscription login, `opus` at `high` **with the served model id `claude-opus-5-5` beside the alias** (L2 note N5), and how the snapshot was identified.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json`: `cardSha256` re-pinned from `212abedb…` to `a6ae8aa6…`, with an `amended` entry (`cardFrom`). The card edit between them is #37781's single line, `claim_line.claim` marked `"masterDetail": true`. That mark reaches the build prompt and the loader, not the scorer, so the build is unchanged and keeps its sha256. Measured: the build re-scored at `b620c4b2` reads Build 140/141 against the card both with and without the mark, no roll-up charge. The one failing check, `master-detail-inline-edit` ("0 edited inline"), fails either way. It comes from a scorer change since the 11-18 build (135/135 then), not from this card edit, and ask rounds do not score Build. It is reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- `packages/qa/scenarios/test/verified-builds.test.ts` (new, L2 note N6). For each `builds/<id>.json` it pins:
  - a provenance file beside it that names this build and this card;
  - the provenance `sha256` equal to the file's own;
  - `cardSha256` equal to the card file in the tree;
  - each `amended` entry's shape;
  - a protocol range the load-time handshake admits for this tree's `PROTOCOL_VERSION` (`checkProtocolCompat`);
  - and that the directory holds a build for every dataset card (the loader's cards with `run.datasetQuestions`).
  The failure messages say what to do: an `amended` entry for a hand edit, a re-score and re-pin for a card edit, a new build when the reading changes.
- `turbo.json` (`@objectstack/scenarios#test` inputs) and `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` (the scenarios row and its `heldBy`) declare `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/*.json`. Without this a build edit would not re-run the suite, and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` refuses it. `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs`'s self-test counts the newly declared glob (23 → 24), in the same shape as #30289's and #31729's entries.
- `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` § Verified builds:
  - the `--template` path is absolute (`"$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/qa/scenarios/builds/<id>.json"`), with why: `pnpm --filter` runs the runner in `packages/qa/scenarios/`, where the repo-relative path names nothing (`readFileSync(args.template)`, `src/runner/cli.ts:628`) (N4);
  - the card-edit re-pin rule;
  - the new test.
- `.claude/skills/scenario-eval/SKILL.md` (net 0 lines):
  - §5's fixture sentence names what installs the build (`--template`) instead of every round (N2);
  - the §4 ask-round comment drops "order_to_cash's build waits on #34986" and has the reader `ls builds/` instead of recalling (N1).

L2 notes (6986428648):
- N1: done by this fixture landing, plus the §4 comment above.
- N2, N4, N5, N6: done as listed.
- N3: void (#37257 ruled, #37271 merged; this build fires no roll-up charge).
- N7: the title is singular.

## Tests

- **The build** (one live run, no retry needed). Command: `run-scenarios --only order_to_cash --modes scratch --packages workspace --author-model opus --author-effort high --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium --no-iterate-run --work … --out … --record …`.
  - Run at `b620c4b2c6`; the working tree also held this PR's docs and test edits, none of them in a packed file. Exit 0.
  - Build 174/174, author `success`, 178/300 turns, 33m 51s, served `claude-opus-5-5` at effort high.
  - Seed 619/619. Run-问数 11/12, Run-operations 6/6 (1 platform half not measured), datasets 4/5. Iterate · Build 186/186 (23 turns).
  - Notional author cost $16.70 over 2 turns (subscription login, not billed).
- **Which snapshot is the verified build.** A poller copied `dist/objectstack.json` every time its content changed (4 copies).
  - Re-scored with `scoreCardArtifact` + `rollupSourceCharges` on the namespaced card: the last two pre-iterate copies both read 174/174.
  - `changeSize` from `5d1696c8` to the post-iterate copy equals the record's iterate change size exactly (12 items). From the earlier `93434753` it does not. So `5d1696c8` is the build the runner verified.
- **Done-when: an ask round on the committed file, no build step.** Command: `run-scenarios --only order_to_cash --modes ask --template "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/qa/scenarios/builds/order_to_cash.json" --packages workspace --ask-model haiku --ask-effort medium`. Exit 0.
  - `template.install` `{ok: true, status: 200}`, `installMode: unmanaged`. Build reads `supplied`, `no authoring turns`.
  - Seed 619/619, Run-问数 11/12, Run-operations 6/6, datasets 4/5, 24 ask turns served `claude-haiku-5-5` at medium.
  - `travel_expense`'s side of the Done-when was met by #35222.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 45 files, 1395 tests passed (before the test's dataset-card read moved to the loader); `test/verified-builds.test.ts` 11/11 after; `typecheck` clean.

## Acceptance notes

- **No changeset**, labelled `skip-changeset`, a deviation from the claim's file surface. The package publishes `dist`, `README.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, and the diff touches none of them:
  - `builds/` is not packed (`scripts/pack-library.mjs` copies `docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` one level deep);
  - `test/` is not in `files[]`;
  - the README edited is `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md`, not the package's.
- **Beyond the claimed surface:** `turbo.json`, `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` (self-test count only). The N6 test reads `builds/`, and the cross-package gate refuses an undeclared input. None of the three files is a governed surface.
- The fixture is pretty-printed as `objectstack build` writes it (5,340 lines), kept byte-exact because the provenance and every round's record name its sha256.

## Verification

- Gate list derived on `c53622d4`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` gives 77 commands; all 77 exited 0, each exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `77 derived, 77 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, the zero DERIVED from the recorded codes.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios test`: 45 files, 1395 tests passed at `c53622d4`; `typecheck` clean.
- Changed lines about 5,500 against the 3,000 human-merge threshold: OVER, as dispatch-gates reports.
